meta_description: John the Handyman provides electrical work and handyman services in Guildford. Fast, reliable trades at fair prices. Call 07762 107270 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Electrician & Handyman — Same-Day Service Available
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to full rewires, John fixes electrical problems fast and treats every job with care.
services_heading: Electrical and Handyman Services Across Guildford
services_subhead: From rewires and consumer unit upgrades to small repairs and installations, John handles all your electrical and general handyman needs.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Complete electrical rewiring to modern safety standards. We handle the lot — new wiring, sockets, lighting, and consumer units — all tested and certified.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuse box? We'll replace it with a modern consumer unit for better safety and performance. Work complies with current Building Regulations.

services.title: Socket and Switch Installation
services.desc: New sockets, switches, and USB charging points installed exactly where you need them. Fast, tidy work with cables routed neatly out of sight.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Trip switches, blown fuses, flickering lights, or faulty appliances? We diagnose and fix the problem the same day, often within hours.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: Kitchen downlights, bathroom fans, outdoor security lighting, and dimmer switches. We design layouts that work and handle all the installation.

services.title: Handyman Repairs & Maintenance
services.desc: Leaky taps, loose door hinges, shelf fitting, painting, and minor carpentry. The jobs electricians don't do — John does them all.

about_pullquote: I fix things properly, charge fairly, and never oversell a customer.
about_para_1: John started in the trades over 15 years ago, learning electrical work from the ground up. After years of working on site, he set up as an independent electrician and handyman in Guildford — offering the same reliability and fair pricing his neighbours and regular customers depend on. He's trained to handle everything from domestic rewires to emergency call-outs.
about_para_2: Guildford locals return to John because he turns up on time, explains what needs doing, and charges a sensible price. He's not interested in cutting corners or pushing jobs that aren't needed. Whether it's a one-off repair or a full house electrical upgrade, John's reputation rests on doing the job right and keeping his word.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Customers Say About John

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that was sparking. John came out same afternoon, found the problem straight away, and fixed it for a fair price. No faffing about, just honest work. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We needed a full kitchen rewire before the new units went in. John organised everything, kept us updated, and finished on time. The electrician we used before wanted nearly twice as much. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Called John at 6pm on a Friday because our lights kept tripping. He came out within the hour, sorted the consumer unit, and we were back to normal by evening. That's the kind of service you don't often find.
reviews.author: David C.
